advice: Target messaging: emphasize product benefits for 46–60 age group and Male customers.
Creative: use short demo videos and user testimonials for wearables like smartwatches.
Timing: schedule posts during evenings and weekends to maximize engagement for working adults.
CTA: highlight trial, limited-time discount, and easy returns to reduce purchase friction.
Audiences: use lookalike audiences on Facebook/Instagram and interest-based targeting on YouTube.
Facebook: Use carousel ads + dynamic product ads; strong for 35-59 age segment.
Instagram: Focus on Reels + influencer partnerships for visual product demos.
Twitter: Use targeted creative and measure performance quickly.
YouTube: Create 15–30s pre-roll demo videos plus product review collaborations.
